text:
On the left, a white benchtop instrument with a blue control panel, red LED display reading "1531", and a keypad sits on a white block platform. On its top deck is a white rack holding an upright tube with red/orange liquid and an orange screw cap, plus an empty clear upright tube. Grey and black cables run up to the wall and across to the right.

At right, a white frame on metal posts supports a black rail with dark clamp fittings and a white box unit; black cables loop down from it.

In the foreground sits a white tray containing a teal/green multi-well block with liquid pooled around it, black clips, and a small white tube lying at the left edge.
